newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends steady in kerb, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends steady in kerb, seen falling.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed steady at 41.15 rupees to the dollar on Monday, but dealers said it might fall on Tuesday amid rising dollar demand.
"Demand (for dollars) seems to be on the rise," a dealer said adding that the rupee might open slightly lower on Tuesday.
The State Bank (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on April 23, was 40.2400/40.4412 to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed unchanged at 2.40 percent.
